JTAPS Rewards Program: Get Paid to Eat at Cincinnati's Best Sports Bar

February 9, 2026 JTAPS Team Rewards

Why Spend Your Money Somewhere Else?

You love JTAPS. You come in for the wings, the gyros, the burgers, the beer, the 50+ TVs, and the electric game day vibe. So why not get rewarded for it?

JTAPS Rewards is our loyalty program designed to say thank you to our best customers. Every time you order at JTAPS, you're earning points that turn into real cash back in your pocket.

The Core Benefit: $10 Back for Every $150 Spent

Here's the simple math: spend $150, get $10 in rewards. That's it. No complicated tiers, no confusing point systems. Just straightforward rewards that add up fast.

Think about it: If you visit JTAPS once a month and spend around $150, you're earning $10 back every month. That's $120 a year just for doing what you already love.

More Than Just Spend & Save

The rewards don't stop at the $10-per-$150 deal. We've loaded the program with exclusive benefits that make being a JTAPS regular even better.

✨ Sign-Up Bonus

Join now and get an immediate bonus just for signing up. It's our way of saying welcome to the club. Start earning right away and use your bonus on your next visit.

🎂 Birthday Bonus

Every year on your birthday, we send you a special bonus as a birthday gift. Come celebrate with us and enjoy extra rewards on your special day.

🎁 Exclusive Coupons

Members get access to exclusive coupons and promotions that aren't available to the general public. Wings night specials, burger deals, happy hour coupons—it all adds up to real savings.

⭐ Member-Only Deals

Throughout the year, we run member-exclusive deals. Flash sales, limited-time offers, and special events—all reserved for our loyal JTAPS community.

How It Works: Three Simple Steps

1. Sign Up

Head to our rewards portal and create your account. It takes two minutes. Provide your name, email, and phone number, and you're in.

2. Start Earning

Every time you order at JTAPS—dine in, takeout, or delivery—your purchase is recorded. As soon as you hit $150 in spending, you earn $10 in rewards. Simple.

3. Check Your Points & Redeem

Log into your account anytime to check your points balance. When you're ready to redeem, just let us know at the counter or apply it to your next order.

Real Rewards, Real Fast

Unlike some loyalty programs where you accumulate points over years, JTAPS Rewards pays out quickly. Every $150 = $10 back. No waiting, no complicated redemptions, no expiration dates (unless otherwise noted).

For a regular who visits twice a month, that's potentially $240 in rewards per year—just for being a loyal customer.

Perfect for Every Visit Type

Game Day Wings Run

Sunday for the NFL game? Toss back $80 in wings and cold beers. Do that twice a month, and you're close to your $150 reward threshold. Boom—free wings next month.

Date Night Dinner

Bringing someone special to JTAPS? Grab some gyros, burgers, and drinks. Spend $75+ and you're halfway to your next reward.

Office Lunch Run

Coordinating lunch for the office? Order a bunch of wings and sandwiches. That's $150+ right there, and your next lunch just got discounted by $10.

Catering & Large Orders

Planning a party or event? Our catering team can help, and every dollar spent counts toward your rewards. Large orders mean faster reward payouts.

Why We Created This Program

JTAPS has been part of Cincinnati since 2006. Our customers aren't just transaction numbers—they're part of our family. We wanted to create a rewards program that actually rewarded loyalty, not punished it with tiny point values and impossible redemption requirements.

JTAPS Rewards is our way of saying: We appreciate you. Come back. We've got your back.

Ready to Start Earning?

Join JTAPS Rewards today and start getting paid to eat at Cincinnati's best sports bar.
